question: Which country will host the International Shooting Sport Federation (ISSF) World Cup in 2027?
solution:
The correct answer is __**India**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **International Shooting Sport Federation (ISSF) World Cup** is a prestigious global event where the world's best shooters compete in various shooting disciplines like rifle, pistol, and shotgun.
 
• **India** has been chosen as the host country for the **2027 ISSF World Cup**, showcasing its capability to host international sporting events.
 
• This decision reflects India's growing prominence in the global shooting sports arena, given its consistent performance and increasing infrastructure for shooting sports.
 
• India has previously hosted several ISSF World Cup events in cities like **New Delhi**, which were highly successful and praised for their organization and facilities.
 
• Hosting the 2027 ISSF World Cup will further enhance India's reputation in the international sports community and provide Indian shooters with a home advantage to compete on the global stage.
